import collections
import lexer = "./lexer.qui"
import parser = "./parser.qui"

class Value(string kind, number := 0, flag := false, text := "", int[] children := [], parameter := parser.Parameter("_", lexer.Position(0, 0, 0)), body := -1, scope_bindings := -1)
class Issue(lexer.Position position, string reason)
class BuiltinResult(Value | none value := none, int | none existing := none, Issue | none issue := none)
class Context(parser.Store syntax, func<BuiltinResult(string, Value, lexer.Position)> builtin, Value[] values := [], map<string, int>[] environments := [], calls := 0, Issue | none issue := none)
class GroupResult(map<string, int> scope_bindings, int[] values)

bool failed(const Context context)
    match context.issue
        Issue found
            return true
        none
            return false

int fail(Context &context, const lexer.Position position, string reason)
    if not failed(context)
        context.issue = Issue(position, reason)
    return -1

int add(Context &context, const Value value)
    index := int(#context.values)
    context.values = context.values.append(value)
    return index

int checked_integer(Context &context, int value, const lexer.Position position)
    if value < -2147483648 or value > 2147483647
        return fail(&context, position, "integer overflow")
    return add(&context, Value("integer", number = value))

int compare_values(Context &context, int first, int second, const lexer.Position position)
    left := context.values[first]
    right := context.values[second]
    if left.kind == "integer"
        return if left.number < right.number then -1 elif left.number > right.number then 1 else 0
    if left.kind == "bool"
        return if left.flag == right.flag then 0 elif left.flag then 1 else -1
    if left.kind == "string"
        return if collections.lex_compare(left.text.codepoints(), right.text.codepoints()) < 0 then -1 elif collections.lex_compare(left.text.codepoints(), right.text.codepoints()) > 0 then 1 else 0
    if left.kind == "pair" or left.kind == "list"
        count := lexer.minimum(int(#left.children), int(#right.children))
        for: index < count
            order := compare_values(&context, left.children[index], right.children[index], position)
            if failed(context) or order != 0
                return order
        return if #left.children < #right.children then -1 elif #left.children > #right.children then 1 else 0
    ignored := fail(&context, position, "functional value compared")
    return 0

bool match_pattern(Context &context, int pattern_index, int value_index, map<string, int> &bindings)
    parser.Pattern pattern := context.syntax.patterns[pattern_index]
    value := context.values[value_index]
    if pattern.kind == "wild"
        return true
    if pattern.kind == "name"
        .bindings.set(pattern.value, value_index)
        return true
    if pattern.kind == "integer"
        number := int(pattern.value)
        return value.kind == "integer" and value.number == number
    if pattern.kind == "bool"
        return value.kind == "bool" and value.flag == (pattern.value == "true")
    if pattern.kind == "string"
        return value.kind == "string" and value.text == pattern.value
    if pattern.kind == "cons"
        if value.kind != "list" or #value.children == 0
            return false
        if not match_pattern(&context, pattern.children[0], value.children[0], &bindings)
            return false
        tail := add(&context, Value("list", children = value.children[1:<int(#value.children)]))
        return match_pattern(&context, pattern.children[1], tail, &bindings)
    if (pattern.kind == "list" and value.kind != "list") or (pattern.kind == "pair" and value.kind != "pair") or #pattern.children != #value.children
        return false
    for: index < int(#pattern.children)
        if not match_pattern(&context, pattern.children[index], value.children[index], &bindings)
            return false
    return true

int evaluate(Context &context, int index, const map<string, int> scope_bindings);

GroupResult evaluate_group(Context &context, int index, const map<string, int> scope_bindings)
    parser.Group group := context.syntax.groups[index]
    recursive := false
    match group.recursive
        lexer.Position position
            recursive = true
        none
            recursive = false
    int[] values := []
    result := scope_bindings
    if recursive
        shared := int(#context.environments)
        context.environments = context.environments.append(scope_bindings)
        for binding := group.bindings[]
            parser.Expr function := context.syntax.expressions[binding.expression]
            closure := add(&context, Value("closure", parameter = function.parameter, body = function.children[0], scope_bindings = shared))
            values = values.append(closure)
            .result.set(binding.name, closure)
        context.environments[shared] = result
    else
        for binding := group.bindings[]
            value := evaluate(&context, binding.expression, scope_bindings)
            if failed(context)
                return GroupResult(scope_bindings, [])
            values = values.append(value)
        for: position < int(#group.bindings)
            .result.set(group.bindings[position].name, values[position])
    return GroupResult(result, values)

int apply(Context &context, int function_index, int argument, const lexer.Position position)
    context.calls += 1
    function := context.values[function_index]
    if function.kind == "closure"
        inner := context.environments[function.scope_bindings]
        if function.parameter.name != "_"
            .inner.set(function.parameter.name, argument)
        return evaluate(&context, function.body, inner)
    operation := context.builtin
    BuiltinResult result := operation(function.text, context.values[argument], position)
    match result.issue
        Issue issue
            context.issue = issue
            return -1
        none
            match result.existing
                int found
                    return found
                none
                    match result.value
                        Value value
                            return add(&context, value)
                        none
                            return fail(&context, position, "invalid builtin result")

int | error required_value(const map<string, int> scope_bindings, string name)
    match scope_bindings.get(name)
        int found
            return found
        none
            return error("missing evaluated binding")

int evaluate(Context &context, int index, const map<string, int> scope_bindings)
    if failed(context)
        return -1
    parser.Expr expression := context.syntax.expressions[index]
    if expression.kind == "integer"
        number := int(expression.value)
        return add(&context, Value("integer", number = number))
    if expression.kind == "bool"
        return add(&context, Value("bool", flag = expression.value == "true"))
    if expression.kind == "string"
        return add(&context, Value("string", text = expression.value))
    if expression.kind == "name"
        found := required_value(scope_bindings, expression.value)
        return found
    if expression.kind == "lambda"
        snapshot := int(#context.environments)
        context.environments = context.environments.append(scope_bindings)
        return add(&context, Value("closure", parameter = expression.parameter, body = expression.children[0], scope_bindings = snapshot))
    if expression.kind == "apply"
        function := evaluate(&context, expression.children[0], scope_bindings)
        if failed(context)
            return -1
        argument := evaluate(&context, expression.children[1], scope_bindings)
        if failed(context)
            return -1
        return apply(&context, function, argument, expression.position)
    if expression.kind == "negate"
        value := evaluate(&context, expression.children[0], scope_bindings)
        if failed(context)
            return -1
        return checked_integer(&context, -context.values[value].number, expression.operator_position)
    if expression.kind == "binary"
        first := evaluate(&context, expression.children[0], scope_bindings)
        if failed(context)
            return -1
        left := context.values[first]
        if expression.value == "&&"
            return if left.flag then evaluate(&context, expression.children[1], scope_bindings) else add(&context, Value("bool", flag = false))
        if expression.value == "||"
            return if left.flag then add(&context, Value("bool", flag = true)) else evaluate(&context, expression.children[1], scope_bindings)
        second := evaluate(&context, expression.children[1], scope_bindings)
        if failed(context)
            return -1
        right := context.values[second]
        if lexer.has(["+", "-", "*", "/", "mod"], expression.value)
            if (expression.value == "/" or expression.value == "mod") and right.number == 0
                return fail(&context, expression.operator_position, "division by zero")
            value := if expression.value == "+" then left.number + right.number elif expression.value == "-" then left.number - right.number elif expression.value == "*" then left.number * right.number elif expression.value == "/" then left.number / right.number else left.number - right.number * (left.number / right.number)
            return checked_integer(&context, value, expression.operator_position)
        if expression.value == "^"
            return add(&context, Value("string", text = left.text + right.text))
        if expression.value == "::"
            return add(&context, Value("list", children = [first].concat(right.children)))
        order := compare_values(&context, first, second, expression.operator_position)
        if failed(context)
            return -1
        result := if expression.value == "=" then order == 0 elif expression.value == "<>" then order != 0 elif expression.value == "<" then order < 0 elif expression.value == ">" then order > 0 elif expression.value == "<=" then order <= 0 else order >= 0
        return add(&context, Value("bool", flag = result))
    if expression.kind == "if"
        condition := evaluate(&context, expression.children[0], scope_bindings)
        if failed(context)
            return -1
        return evaluate(&context, if context.values[condition].flag then expression.children[1] else expression.children[2], scope_bindings)
    if expression.kind == "pair" or expression.kind == "list"
        int[] values := []
        for child := expression.children[]
            value := evaluate(&context, child, scope_bindings)
            if failed(context)
                return -1
            values = values.append(value)
        return add(&context, Value(expression.kind, children = values))
    if expression.kind == "match"
        matched := evaluate(&context, expression.children[0], scope_bindings)
        if failed(context)
            return -1
        for arm := expression.arms[]
            map<string, int> bindings
            if match_pattern(&context, arm.pattern, matched, &bindings)
                inner := scope_bindings
                keys := bindings.keys()
                for key := keys[]
                    value := required_value(bindings, key)
                    .inner.set(key, value)
                return evaluate(&context, arm.body, inner)
        return fail(&context, expression.position, "match failure")
    result := evaluate_group(&context, expression.group, scope_bindings)
    if failed(context)
        return -1
    return evaluate(&context, expression.children[0], result.scope_bindings)

import lexer = "./lexer.qui"
import parser = "./parser.qui"
import un = "./unifier.qui"

class Issue(lexer.Position position, string kind, message := "", expected := -1, found := -1, un.Failure | none failure := none, string[] names := [])
class Local(string name, lexer.Position position, un.Scheme scheme)
class MatchRecord(int expression, int type)
class Context(un.Store types, parser.Store syntax, Local[] locals := [], MatchRecord[] matches := [], Issue | none issue := none)
class GroupResult(map<string, un.Scheme> scope_bindings, un.Scheme[] schemes)

bool failed(const Context context)
    match context.issue
        Issue found
            return true
        none
            return false

void fail(Context &context, const Issue issue)
    if not failed(context)
        context.issue = issue

void check(Context &context, int expected, int found, const lexer.Position position)
    if failed(context)
        return
    match un.unify(&context.types, expected, found)
        un.Failure failure
            fail(&context, Issue(position, "check", expected = expected, found = found, failure = failure))
        none
            context.issue = none

int infer_expression(Context &context, int index, const map<string, un.Scheme> scope_bindings);

int infer_pattern(Context &context, int index, map<string, int> &bindings)
    if failed(context)
        return -1
    parser.Pattern pattern := context.syntax.patterns[index]
    if pattern.kind == "wild"
        return un.fresh(&context.types)
    if pattern.kind == "name"
        if bindings.has(pattern.value)
            fail(&context, Issue(pattern.position, "message", "variable '{pattern.value}' is bound twice in this pattern"))
            return -1
        type := un.fresh(&context.types)
        .bindings.set(pattern.value, type)
        return type
    if lexer.has(["integer", "bool", "string"], pattern.kind)
        return un.add(&context.types, if pattern.kind == "integer" then "int" else pattern.kind)
    if pattern.kind == "cons"
        type := un.fresh(&context.types)
        head := infer_pattern(&context, pattern.children[0], &bindings)
        check(&context, type, head, context.syntax.patterns[pattern.children[0]].position)
        if failed(context)
            return -1
        tail := infer_pattern(&context, pattern.children[1], &bindings)
        list := un.add(&context.types, "list", type)
        check(&context, list, tail, context.syntax.patterns[pattern.children[1]].position)
        return if failed(context) then -1 else list
    if pattern.kind == "list"
        type := un.fresh(&context.types)
        for child := pattern.children[]
            found := infer_pattern(&context, child, &bindings)
            check(&context, type, found, context.syntax.patterns[child].position)
            if failed(context)
                return -1
        return un.add(&context.types, "list", type)
    first := infer_pattern(&context, pattern.children[0], &bindings)
    if failed(context)
        return -1
    second := infer_pattern(&context, pattern.children[1], &bindings)
    return if failed(context) then -1 else un.add(&context.types, "pair", first, second)

GroupResult infer_group(Context &context, int index, const map<string, un.Scheme> scope_bindings, bool local_bindings)
    parser.Group group := context.syntax.groups[index]
    string[] names := []
    recursive := false
    match group.recursive
        lexer.Position position
            recursive = true
        none
            recursive = false
    for binding := group.bindings[]
        if lexer.has(names, binding.name)
            fail(&context, Issue(binding.position, "message", "variable '{binding.name}' is bound twice in this let"))
            return GroupResult(scope_bindings, [])
        names = names.append(binding.name)
        if recursive and context.syntax.expressions[binding.expression].kind != "lambda"
            fail(&context, Issue(binding.position, "message", "'{binding.name}' in let rec must be a function"))
            return GroupResult(scope_bindings, [])
    recursive_environment := scope_bindings
    int[] inferred := []
    if recursive
        for binding := group.bindings[]
            type := un.fresh(&context.types)
            inferred = inferred.append(type)
            .recursive_environment.set(binding.name, un.Scheme(type))
        for: position < int(#group.bindings)
            parser.Binding binding := group.bindings[position]
            found := infer_expression(&context, binding.expression, recursive_environment)
            check(&context, inferred[position], found, binding.position)
            if failed(context)
                return GroupResult(scope_bindings, [])
    else
        for binding := group.bindings[]
            found := infer_expression(&context, binding.expression, scope_bindings)
            if failed(context)
                return GroupResult(scope_bindings, [])
            inferred = inferred.append(found)
    un.Scheme[] schemes := []
    result := scope_bindings
    for: position < int(#group.bindings)
        parser.Binding binding := group.bindings[position]
        scheme := un.generalize(context.types, inferred[position], scope_bindings)
        schemes = schemes.append(scheme)
        .result.set(binding.name, scheme)
        if local_bindings
            context.locals = context.locals.append(Local(binding.name, binding.position, scheme))
    return GroupResult(result, schemes)

int infer_expression(Context &context, int index, const map<string, un.Scheme> scope_bindings)
    if failed(context)
        return -1
    parser.Expr expression := context.syntax.expressions[index]
    if lexer.has(["integer", "bool", "string"], expression.kind)
        return un.add(&context.types, if expression.kind == "integer" then "int" else expression.kind)
    if expression.kind == "name"
        match scope_bindings.get(expression.value)
            un.Scheme scheme
                return un.instantiate(&context.types, scheme)
            none
                fail(&context, Issue(expression.position, "unbound", expression.value, names = scope_bindings.keys()))
                return -1
    if expression.kind == "lambda"
        argument := un.fresh(&context.types)
        inner := scope_bindings
        if expression.parameter.name != "_"
            .inner.set(expression.parameter.name, un.Scheme(argument))
        result := infer_expression(&context, expression.children[0], inner)
        return if failed(context) then -1 else un.add(&context.types, "function", argument, result)
    if expression.kind == "apply"
        initial := infer_expression(&context, expression.children[0], scope_bindings)
        if failed(context)
            return -1
        function_index := un.resolve(context.types, initial)
        un.Type function_type := context.types.nodes[function_index]
        expected := -1
        result := -1
        if function_type.kind == "variable"
            expected = un.fresh(&context.types)
            result = un.fresh(&context.types)
            function := un.add(&context.types, "function", expected, result)
            context.types.nodes[function_index].binding = function
        elif function_type.kind == "function"
            expected = function_type.first
            result = function_type.second
        else
            fail(&context, Issue(context.syntax.expressions[expression.children[0]].position, "function", found = function_index))
            return -1
        found := infer_expression(&context, expression.children[1], scope_bindings)
        check(&context, expected, found, context.syntax.expressions[expression.children[1]].position)
        return if failed(context) then -1 else result
    if expression.kind == "binary"
        first_type := -1
        second_type := -1
        result := -1
        if lexer.has(["+", "-", "*", "/", "mod"], expression.value)
            first_type = un.add(&context.types, "int")
            second_type = first_type
            result = first_type
        elif expression.value == "^"
            first_type = un.add(&context.types, "string")
            second_type = first_type
            result = first_type
        elif expression.value == "&&" or expression.value == "||"
            first_type = un.add(&context.types, "bool")
            second_type = first_type
            result = first_type
        elif expression.value == "::"
            first_type = un.fresh(&context.types)
            second_type = un.add(&context.types, "list", first_type)
            result = second_type
        else
            first_type = un.fresh(&context.types)
            second_type = first_type
            result = un.add(&context.types, "bool")
        first := infer_expression(&context, expression.children[0], scope_bindings)
        check(&context, first_type, first, context.syntax.expressions[expression.children[0]].position)
        if failed(context)
            return -1
        second := infer_expression(&context, expression.children[1], scope_bindings)
        check(&context, second_type, second, context.syntax.expressions[expression.children[1]].position)
        return if failed(context) then -1 else result
    if expression.kind == "negate"
        found := infer_expression(&context, expression.children[0], scope_bindings)
        expected := un.add(&context.types, "int")
        check(&context, expected, found, context.syntax.expressions[expression.children[0]].position)
        return if failed(context) then -1 else expected
    if expression.kind == "if"
        condition := infer_expression(&context, expression.children[0], scope_bindings)
        expected := un.add(&context.types, "bool")
        check(&context, expected, condition, context.syntax.expressions[expression.children[0]].position)
        if failed(context)
            return -1
        first := infer_expression(&context, expression.children[1], scope_bindings)
        if failed(context)
            return -1
        second := infer_expression(&context, expression.children[2], scope_bindings)
        check(&context, first, second, context.syntax.expressions[expression.children[2]].position)
        return if failed(context) then -1 else first
    if expression.kind == "pair"
        first := infer_expression(&context, expression.children[0], scope_bindings)
        if failed(context)
            return -1
        second := infer_expression(&context, expression.children[1], scope_bindings)
        return if failed(context) then -1 else un.add(&context.types, "pair", first, second)
    if expression.kind == "list"
        type := un.fresh(&context.types)
        for child := expression.children[]
            found := infer_expression(&context, child, scope_bindings)
            check(&context, type, found, context.syntax.expressions[child].position)
            if failed(context)
                return -1
        return un.add(&context.types, "list", type)
    if expression.kind == "match"
        type := infer_expression(&context, expression.children[0], scope_bindings)
        if failed(context)
            return -1
        result := un.fresh(&context.types)
        for arm := expression.arms[]
            map<string, int> bindings
            found := infer_pattern(&context, arm.pattern, &bindings)
            check(&context, type, found, context.syntax.patterns[arm.pattern].position)
            if failed(context)
                return -1
            inner := scope_bindings
            keys := bindings.keys()
            for key := keys[]
                match bindings.get(key)
                    int value
                        .inner.set(key, un.Scheme(value))
                    none
                        inner = inner
            body_type := infer_expression(&context, arm.body, inner)
            check(&context, result, body_type, context.syntax.expressions[arm.body].position)
            if failed(context)
                return -1
        context.matches = context.matches.append(MatchRecord(index, type))
        return result
    group_result := infer_group(&context, expression.group, scope_bindings, true)
    if failed(context)
        return -1
    return infer_expression(&context, expression.children[0], group_result.scope_bindings)

class Position(int file_index, int line, int column)
class Token(string kind, string spelling, string value, Position position)

bool has<T>(const T[] items, T sought)
    for item := items[]
        if item == sought
            return true
    return false

int minimum(int first, int second)
    return if first < second then first else second

int maximum(int first, int second)
    return if first > second then first else second

string repeat(string text, int count)
    result := ""
    for: iteration < count
        result += text
    return result

int compare_position(const Position first, const Position second)
    if first.file_index != second.file_index
        return if first.file_index < second.file_index then -1 else 1
    if first.line != second.line
        return if first.line < second.line then -1 else 1
    return if first.column < second.column then -1 elif first.column > second.column then 1 else 0

bool letter(string character)
    return (character.codepoints()[0] >= 65 and character.codepoints()[0] <= 90) or (character.codepoints()[0] >= 97 and character.codepoints()[0] <= 122)

bool digit(string character)
    return character.codepoints()[0] >= 48 and character.codepoints()[0] <= 57

Token[] lex(string text, int file_index)
    Position[] positions := []
    row := 1
    column := 1
    for: position < int(#text)
        positions = positions.append(Position(file_index, row, column))
        if text[position] == NL
            row += 1
            column = 1
        else
            column += 1
    positions = positions.append(Position(file_index, row, column))
    Token[] tokens := []
    position := 0
    while position < int(#text)
        character := text[position]
        if character == " " or character == NL
            position += 1
            continue
        start := position
        kind := ""
        value := ""
        if text[position:<int(#text)].starts_with("(*")
            finish := position + 2
            while finish + 1 < int(#text) and text[finish:<finish + 2] != "*)"
                finish += 1
            if finish + 1 < int(#text)
                position = finish + 2
                continue
            tokens = tokens.append(Token("invalid", text[start:<int(#text)], "unterminated comment", positions[start]))
            break
        elif digit(character)
            position += 1
            while position < int(#text) and digit(text[position])
                position += 1
            number := int(text[start:<position])
            kind = if number <= 2147483647 then "integer" else "invalid"
            value = if kind == "integer" then string(number) else "integer literal too large"
        elif letter(character) or character == "_"
            position += 1
            while position < int(#text) and (letter(text[position]) or digit(text[position]) or text[position] == "_" or text[position] == "'")
                position += 1
            value = text[start:<position]
            kind = if has(["let", "rec", "and", "in", "fun", "if", "then", "else", "match", "with", "true", "false", "mod", "val"], value) then "keyword" else "identifier"
        elif character == "'" and position + 1 < int(#text) and text[position + 1].codepoints()[0] >= 97 and text[position + 1].codepoints()[0] <= 122
            position += 2
            while position < int(#text) and (letter(text[position]) or digit(text[position]) or text[position] == "_")
                position += 1
            kind = "type_variable"
            value = text[start:<position]
        elif character == DQ
            position += 1
            closed := false
            valid := true
            decoded := ""
            while position < int(#text) and text[position] != NL
                if text[position] == DQ
                    position += 1
                    closed = true
                    break
                if text[position] == "\" and position + 1 < int(#text) and text[position + 1] != NL
                    escaped := text[position + 1]
                    if escaped == "n"
                        decoded += NL
                    elif escaped == "t"
                        decoded += HT
                    elif escaped == "\" or escaped == DQ
                        decoded += escaped
                    else
                        valid = false
                    position += 2
                elif text[position] == "\"
                    position += 1
                else
                    decoded += text[position]
                    position += 1
            kind = if closed and valid then "string" else "invalid"
            value = if not closed then "unterminated string" elif not valid then "invalid escape sequence" else decoded
        else
            if position + 1 < int(#text) and has([";;", "->", "::", "||", "&&", "<=", ">=", "<>"], text[position:<position + 2])
                position += 2
                kind = "symbol"
                value = text[start:<position]
            elif ":;=<>+-*/^()[],|".contains(character)
                position += 1
                kind = "symbol"
                value = character
            else
                position += 1
                kind = "invalid"
                value = "illegal character '{character}'"
        tokens = tokens.append(Token(kind, text[start:<position], value, positions[start]))
    tokens = tokens.append(Token("eof", "", "", positions[-1]))
    return tokens
