import un = "./unifier.qui"
import inference = "./inference.qui"
import evaluator = "./evaluator.qui"

string quote(string text)
    string result := DQ
    for: position < int(#text)
        character := text[position]
        if character == "\"
            result += "\\"
        elif character == DQ
            result += "\" + DQ
        elif character == NL
            result += "\n"
        elif character == HT
            result += "\t"
        else
            result += character
    return result + DQ

string value_text(const evaluator.Context runtime, int index)
    evaluator.Value value := runtime.values[index]
    if value.kind == "integer"
        return string(value.number)
    if value.kind == "bool"
        return if value.flag then "true" else "false"
    if value.kind == "string"
        return quote(value.text)
    if value.kind == "pair"
        return "({value_text(runtime, value.children[0])}, {value_text(runtime, value.children[1])})"
    if value.kind == "list"
        string[] elements := []
        for child := value.children[]
            elements = elements.append(value_text(runtime, child))
        return "[{elements.join("; ")}]"
    return "<fun>"

evaluator.BuiltinResult apply_builtin(string name, evaluator.Value argument, lexer.Position position)
    if name == "fst"
        return evaluator.BuiltinResult(existing = argument.children[0])
    if name == "snd"
        return evaluator.BuiltinResult(existing = argument.children[1])
    if name == "not"
        return evaluator.BuiltinResult(value = evaluator.Value("bool", flag = not argument.flag))
    if name == "string_of_int"
        return evaluator.BuiltinResult(value = evaluator.Value("string", text = string(argument.number)))
    return evaluator.BuiltinResult(issue = evaluator.Issue(position, "failure {quote(argument.text)}"))

int edit_distance(string first, string second)
    int[] row := []
    for: position < int(#second) + 1
        row = row.append(position)
    for: first_index < int(#first)
        next := [first_index + 1]
        for: second_index < int(#second)
            changed := row[second_index] + (if first[first_index] == second[second_index] then 0 else 1)
            next = next.append(lexer.minimum(lexer.minimum(next[second_index] + 1, row[second_index + 1] + 1), changed))
        row = next
    return row[int(#second)]

class Naming(names := map<int, string>(), int[] | none quantified := none)

string type_text(const un.Store types, int index, Naming &naming);

string wrapped_type(const un.Store types, int index, bool pair, Naming &naming)
    resolved := un.resolve(types, index)
    text := type_text(types, resolved, &naming)
    string kind := types.nodes[resolved].kind
    return if kind == "function" or (pair and kind == "pair") then "({text})" else text

string type_text(const un.Store types, int index, Naming &naming)
    resolved := un.resolve(types, index)
    un.Type type := types.nodes[resolved]
    if type.kind == "variable"
        match naming.names.get(resolved)
            string found
                return found
            none
                count := int(naming.names.size())
                alphabet := "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
                suffix := if count >= 26 then string(count / 26) else ""
                prefix := "'"
                match naming.quantified
                    int[] quantified
                        if not un.has(quantified, resolved)
                            prefix += "_"
                    none
                        prefix = prefix
                name := prefix + alphabet[count % 26] + suffix
                .naming.names.set(resolved, name)
                return name
    if type.kind == "list"
        return wrapped_type(types, type.first, true, &naming) + " list"
    if type.kind == "pair"
        first := wrapped_type(types, type.first, true, &naming)
        second := wrapped_type(types, type.second, true, &naming)
        return first + " * " + second
    if type.kind == "function"
        first := wrapped_type(types, type.first, false, &naming)
        second := type_text(types, type.second, &naming)
        return first + " -> " + second
    return type.kind

string issue_message(const inference.Issue issue, const un.Store types)
    naming := Naming()
    if issue.kind == "message"
        return issue.message
    if issue.kind == "unbound"
        chosen := ""
        best := 3
        ordered := issue.names.sorted()
        for name := ordered[]
            distance := edit_distance(issue.message, name)
            if distance <= 2 and distance < int(#issue.message) and distance < best
                chosen = name
                best = distance
        suffix := if chosen == "" then "" else " (did you mean '{chosen}'?)"
        return "unbound variable '{issue.message}'{suffix}"
    if issue.kind == "function"
        return "expected a function but found {type_text(types, issue.found, &naming)}"
    expected := type_text(types, issue.expected, &naming)
    found := type_text(types, issue.found, &naming)
    result := "expected {expected} but found {found}"
    match issue.failure
        un.Failure failure
            if failure.occurs
                first := un.resolve(types, failure.expected)
                expected_variable := types.nodes[first].kind == "variable"
                variable := if expected_variable then failure.expected else failure.found
                other := if expected_variable then failure.found else failure.expected
                variable_text := type_text(types, variable, &naming)
                other_text := type_text(types, other, &naming)
                result += " (infinite type {variable_text} = {other_text})"
            elif failure.nested
                first := type_text(types, failure.expected, &naming)
                second := type_text(types, failure.found, &naming)
                result += " ({first} vs {second})"
        none
            result = result
    return result

int signature_type(const parser.Store syntax, int index, un.Store &types, map<string, int> &variables)
    parser.TypeSyntax type := syntax.types[index]
    if type.kind == "variable"
        match variables.get(type.value)
            int found
                return found
            none
                created := un.fresh(&types)
                .variables.set(type.value, created)
                return created
    if type.kind == "list"
        element := signature_type(syntax, type.children[0], &types, &variables)
        return un.add(&types, "list", element)
    if type.kind == "pair" or type.kind == "function"
        first := signature_type(syntax, type.children[0], &types, &variables)
        second := signature_type(syntax, type.children[1], &types, &variables)
        return un.add(&types, type.kind, first, second)
    return un.add(&types, type.kind)

bool signature_matches(const un.Store types, int inferred, int declared, map<int, int> &assigned)
    first := un.resolve(types, inferred)
    second := un.resolve(types, declared)
    un.Type left := types.nodes[first]
    un.Type right := types.nodes[second]
    if left.kind == "variable"
        match assigned.get(first)
            int old
                return un.same(types, old, second)
            none
                .assigned.set(first, second)
                return true
    if left.kind != right.kind
        return false
    if left.kind == "list"
        return signature_matches(types, left.first, right.first, &assigned)
    if left.kind == "pair" or left.kind == "function"
        return signature_matches(types, left.first, right.first, &assigned) and signature_matches(types, left.second, right.second, &assigned)
    return un.same(types, first, second)

string type_syntax(const parser.Store syntax, int index);

string wrapped_syntax(const parser.Store syntax, int index, bool pair)
    parser.TypeSyntax type := syntax.types[index]
    text := type_syntax(syntax, index)
    return if type.kind == "function" or (pair and type.kind == "pair") then "({text})" else text

string type_syntax(const parser.Store syntax, int index)
    parser.TypeSyntax type := syntax.types[index]
    if type.kind == "variable"
        return type.value
    if type.kind == "list"
        return wrapped_syntax(syntax, type.children[0], true) + " list"
    if type.kind == "pair"
        return wrapped_syntax(syntax, type.children[0], true) + " * " + wrapped_syntax(syntax, type.children[1], true)
    if type.kind == "function"
        return wrapped_syntax(syntax, type.children[0], false) + " -> " + type_syntax(syntax, type.children[1])
    return type.kind

string pattern_text(const parser.Store syntax, int index)
    parser.Pattern pattern := syntax.patterns[index]
    if pattern.kind == "wild"
        return "_"
    if pattern.kind == "name" or pattern.kind == "integer" or pattern.kind == "bool"
        return pattern.value
    if pattern.kind == "string"
        return quote(pattern.value)
    if pattern.kind == "pair"
        return "({pattern_text(syntax, pattern.children[0])}, {pattern_text(syntax, pattern.children[1])})"
    if pattern.kind == "list"
        string[] children := []
        for child := pattern.children[]
            children = children.append(pattern_text(syntax, child))
        return "[{children.join("; ")}]"
    first := pattern_text(syntax, pattern.children[0])
    if syntax.patterns[pattern.children[0]].kind == "cons"
        first = "({first})"
    return first + " :: " + pattern_text(syntax, pattern.children[1])

string expression_text(const parser.Store syntax, int index, int required);

string group_text(const parser.Store syntax, int index)
    parser.Group group := syntax.groups[index]
    prefix := "let "
    match group.recursive
        lexer.Position position
            prefix += "rec "
        none
            prefix = prefix
    string[] bindings := []
    for binding := group.bindings[]
        int body := binding.expression
        string[] names := [binding.name]
        while syntax.expressions[body].kind == "lambda"
            names = names.append(syntax.expressions[body].parameter.name)
            body = syntax.expressions[body].children[0]
        bindings = bindings.append(names.join(" ") + " = " + expression_text(syntax, body, 0))
    return prefix + bindings.join(" and ")

bool ends_in_match(const parser.Store syntax, int index)
    parser.Expr expression := syntax.expressions[index]
    if expression.kind == "match"
        return true
    if expression.kind == "let" or expression.kind == "lambda"
        return ends_in_match(syntax, expression.children[0])
    if expression.kind == "if"
        return ends_in_match(syntax, expression.children[2])
    return false

string expression_text(const parser.Store syntax, int index, int required)
    parser.Expr expression := syntax.expressions[index]
    text := ""
    strength := 9
    if lexer.has(["integer", "bool", "name"], expression.kind)
        text = expression.value
    elif expression.kind == "string"
        text = quote(expression.value)
    elif expression.kind == "lambda"
        body := index
        string[] names := []
        while syntax.expressions[body].kind == "lambda"
            names = names.append(syntax.expressions[body].parameter.name)
            body = syntax.expressions[body].children[0]
        strength = 0
        text = "fun {names.join(" ")} -> {expression_text(syntax, body, 0)}"
    elif expression.kind == "apply"
        strength = 8
        text = expression_text(syntax, expression.children[0], 8) + " " + expression_text(syntax, expression.children[1], 9)
    elif expression.kind == "binary"
        strength = parser.precedence(expression.value)
        right := parser.right_associative(expression.value)
        text = expression_text(syntax, expression.children[0], strength + (if right then 1 else 0)) + " " + expression.value + " " + expression_text(syntax, expression.children[1], strength + (if right then 0 else 1))
    elif expression.kind == "negate"
        strength = 7
        text = "-" + expression_text(syntax, expression.children[0], 7)
    elif expression.kind == "if"
        strength = 0
        text = "if {expression_text(syntax, expression.children[0], 0)} then {expression_text(syntax, expression.children[1], 0)} else {expression_text(syntax, expression.children[2], 0)}"
    elif expression.kind == "pair"
        text = "({expression_text(syntax, expression.children[0], 0)}, {expression_text(syntax, expression.children[1], 0)})"
    elif expression.kind == "list"
        string[] children := []
        for child := expression.children[]
            children = children.append(expression_text(syntax, child, 0))
        text = "[{children.join("; ")}]"
    elif expression.kind == "let"
        strength = 0
        text = group_text(syntax, expression.group) + " in " + expression_text(syntax, expression.children[0], 0)
    else
        strength = 0
        string[] arms := []
        for: position < int(#expression.arms)
            parser.Arm arm := expression.arms[position]
            written := expression_text(syntax, arm.body, 0)
            if position + 1 < int(#expression.arms) and ends_in_match(syntax, arm.body)
                written = "({written})"
            arms = arms.append(pattern_text(syntax, arm.pattern) + " -> " + written)
        text = "match {expression_text(syntax, expression.children[0], 0)} with {arms.join(" | ") }"
    return if strength < required then "({text})" else text

string item_text(const parser.Store syntax, const parser.Item item)
    if item.kind == "signature"
        return "val {item.name} : {type_syntax(syntax, item.type)};;"
    if item.kind == "declaration"
        return group_text(syntax, item.group) + ";;"
    return expression_text(syntax, item.expression, 0) + ";;"

class Cover(string constructor, int[] arguments := [])
class Covers(items := [Cover("wild")])
class NamePosition(string name, lexer.Position position)
class Reference(lexer.Position target, bool tail)
class Warning(lexer.Position position, int order, string message)
class Classification(lexer.Position position, string text)
class Inspection(Warning[] warnings := [], Classification[] classifications := [], NamePosition[] candidates := [], covers := Covers())

int add_cover(Covers &store, string constructor, const int[] arguments := [])
    index := int(#store.items)
    store.items = store.items.append(Cover(constructor, arguments))
    return index

int cover_pattern(const parser.Store syntax, int index, Covers &store)
    parser.Pattern pattern := syntax.patterns[index]
    if pattern.kind == "wild" or pattern.kind == "name"
        return 0
    if pattern.kind == "integer"
        return add_cover(&store, "i" + pattern.value)
    if pattern.kind == "string"
        return add_cover(&store, "s" + quote(pattern.value))
    if pattern.kind == "bool"
        return add_cover(&store, pattern.value)
    if pattern.kind == "list"
        tail := add_cover(&store, "nil")
        backwards := pattern.children[::-1]
        for child := backwards[]
            head := cover_pattern(syntax, child, &store)
            tail = add_cover(&store, "cons", [head, tail])
        return tail
    first := cover_pattern(syntax, pattern.children[0], &store)
    second := cover_pattern(syntax, pattern.children[1], &store)
    return add_cover(&store, if pattern.kind == "pair" then "pair" else "cons", [first, second])

int[] constructor_arguments(const un.Store types, int type_index, string constructor)
    index := un.resolve(types, type_index)
    un.Type type := types.nodes[index]
    if type.kind == "list" and constructor == "cons"
        return [type.first, index]
    if type.kind == "pair"
        return [type.first, type.second]
    return []

int[][] specialize(const Covers store, const int[][] matrix, string constructor, int arity)
    int[][] result := []
    for row := matrix[]
        first := store.items[row[0]]
        tail := row[1:<int(#row)]
        if first.constructor == "wild"
            wilds := array(nat(arity), fill = 0)
            result = result.append(wilds.concat(tail))
        elif first.constructor == constructor
            result = result.append(first.arguments.concat(tail))
    return result

bool useful(const un.Store types, const Covers store, const int[][] matrix, const int[] vector, const int[] column_types)
    if #vector == 0
        return #matrix == 0
    first := store.items[vector[0]]
    tail := vector[1:<int(#vector)]
    type_tail := column_types[1:<int(#column_types)]
    if first.constructor != "wild"
        selected := specialize(store, matrix, first.constructor, int(#first.arguments))
        arguments := constructor_arguments(types, column_types[0], first.constructor)
        return useful(types, store, selected, first.arguments.concat(tail), arguments.concat(type_tail))
    un.Type type := types.nodes[un.resolve(types, column_types[0])]
    string[] family := if type.kind == "bool" then ["false", "true"] elif type.kind == "list" then ["nil", "cons"] elif type.kind == "pair" then ["pair"] else []
    string[] present := []
    for row := matrix[]
        constructor := store.items[row[0]].constructor
        if constructor != "wild" and not lexer.has(present, constructor)
            present = present.append(constructor)
    complete := #family > 0
    for constructor := family[]
        if not lexer.has(present, constructor)
            complete = false
    if complete
        for constructor := family[]
            arguments := constructor_arguments(types, column_types[0], constructor)
            wilds := array(#arguments, fill = 0)
            selected := specialize(store, matrix, constructor, int(#arguments))
            if useful(types, store, selected, wilds.concat(tail), arguments.concat(type_tail))
                return true
        return false
    int[][] defaults := []
    for row := matrix[]
        if store.items[row[0]].constructor == "wild"
            defaults = defaults.append(row[1:<int(#row)])
    return useful(types, store, defaults, tail, type_tail)

NamePosition[] pattern_names(const parser.Store syntax, int index)
    parser.Pattern pattern := syntax.patterns[index]
    if pattern.kind == "name"
        return [NamePosition(pattern.value, pattern.position)]
    NamePosition[] result := []
    for child := pattern.children[]
        result = result.concat(pattern_names(syntax, child))
    return result

map<string, lexer.Position> add_names(const map<string, lexer.Position> scope, const NamePosition[] names)
    result := scope
    for entry := names[]
        .result.set(entry.name, entry.position)
    return result

map<string, lexer.Position> group_scope(const parser.Group group, const map<string, lexer.Position> scope)
    result := scope
    for binding := group.bindings[]
        .result.set(binding.name, binding.position)
    return result

bool recursive_group(const parser.Group group)
    match group.recursive
        lexer.Position position
            return true
        none
            return false

Reference[] pure_references(const parser.Store syntax, int index, const map<string, lexer.Position> scope, bool tail)
    parser.Expr expression := syntax.expressions[index]
    if expression.kind == "name"
        match scope.get(expression.value)
            lexer.Position target
                return [Reference(target, false)]
            none
                return []
    if expression.kind == "lambda"
        inner := scope
        if expression.parameter.name != "_"
            .inner.set(expression.parameter.name, expression.parameter.position)
        return pure_references(syntax, expression.children[0], inner, false)
    if expression.kind == "apply"
        head := index
        int[] arguments := []
        while syntax.expressions[head].kind == "apply"
            arguments = arguments.append(syntax.expressions[head].children[1])
            head = syntax.expressions[head].children[0]
        Reference[] result := []
        if syntax.expressions[head].kind == "name"
            match scope.get(syntax.expressions[head].value)
                lexer.Position target
                    result = [Reference(target, tail)]
                none
                    result = []
        else
            result = pure_references(syntax, head, scope, false)
        backwards := arguments[::-1]
        for argument := backwards[]
            result = result.concat(pure_references(syntax, argument, scope, false))
        return result
    if expression.kind == "binary"
        first := pure_references(syntax, expression.children[0], scope, false)
        return first.concat(pure_references(syntax, expression.children[1], scope, tail and (expression.value == "&&" or expression.value == "||")))
    if expression.kind == "if"
        result := pure_references(syntax, expression.children[0], scope, false)
        result = result.concat(pure_references(syntax, expression.children[1], scope, tail))
        return result.concat(pure_references(syntax, expression.children[2], scope, tail))
    if expression.kind == "match"
        result := pure_references(syntax, expression.children[0], scope, false)
        for arm := expression.arms[]
            inner := add_names(scope, pattern_names(syntax, arm.pattern))
            result = result.concat(pure_references(syntax, arm.body, inner, tail))
        return result
    if expression.kind == "let"
        parser.Group group := syntax.groups[expression.group]
        inner := group_scope(group, scope)
        rhs := if recursive_group(group) then inner else scope
        Reference[] result := []
        for binding := group.bindings[]
            result = result.concat(pure_references(syntax, binding.expression, rhs, false))
        return result.concat(pure_references(syntax, expression.children[0], inner, tail))
    Reference[] result := []
    for child := expression.children[]
        result = result.concat(pure_references(syntax, child, scope, false))
    return result

int | error match_type(const inference.Context context, int index)
    for entry := context.matches[]
        if entry.expression == index
            return entry.type
    return error("missing inferred match type")

void inspect_walk(const inference.Context context, int index, const map<string, lexer.Position> scope, Inspection &inspection);

map<string, lexer.Position> inspect_group(const inference.Context context, int index, const map<string, lexer.Position> scope, bool top, Inspection &inspection)
    parser.Group group := context.syntax.groups[index]
    inner := group_scope(group, scope)
    lexer.Position[] names := []
    for binding := group.bindings[]
        names = names.append(binding.position)
        if not top
            inspection.candidates = inspection.candidates.append(NamePosition(binding.name, binding.position))
    recursive := recursive_group(group)
    rhs := if recursive then inner else scope
    for binding := group.bindings[]
        inspect_walk(context, binding.expression, rhs, &inspection)
    if recursive
        used := false
        for binding := group.bindings[]
            references := pure_references(context.syntax, binding.expression, inner, false)
            for reference := references[]
                if lexer.has(names, reference.target)
                    used = true
        if not used
            match group.recursive
                lexer.Position position
                    inspection.warnings = inspection.warnings.append(Warning(position, 3, "unused rec flag"))
                none
                    inspection.warnings = inspection.warnings
        for binding := group.bindings[]
            int body := binding.expression
            body_scope := inner
            while context.syntax.expressions[body].kind == "lambda"
                parser.Parameter argument := context.syntax.expressions[body].parameter
                if argument.name != "_"
                    .body_scope.set(argument.name, argument.position)
                body = context.syntax.expressions[body].children[0]
            references := pure_references(context.syntax, body, body_scope, true)
            present := false
            all_tail := true
            for reference := references[]
                if lexer.has(names, reference.target)
                    present = true
                    all_tail = all_tail and reference.tail
            if present
                inspection.classifications = inspection.classifications.append(Classification(binding.position, if all_tail then "tail recursive" else "recursive"))
    return inner

void inspect_walk(const inference.Context context, int index, const map<string, lexer.Position> scope, Inspection &inspection)
    parser.Expr expression := context.syntax.expressions[index]
    if expression.kind == "lambda"
        inner := scope
        if expression.parameter.name != "_"
            inspection.candidates = inspection.candidates.append(NamePosition(expression.parameter.name, expression.parameter.position))
            .inner.set(expression.parameter.name, expression.parameter.position)
        inspect_walk(context, expression.children[0], inner, &inspection)
        return
    if expression.kind == "let"
        inner := inspect_group(context, expression.group, scope, false, &inspection)
        inspect_walk(context, expression.children[0], inner, &inspection)
        return
    if expression.kind == "match"
        type := match_type(context, index)
        int[][] matrix := []
        for: position < int(#expression.arms)
            parser.Arm arm := expression.arms[position]
            candidate := cover_pattern(context.syntax, arm.pattern, &inspection.covers)
            if position > 0 and not useful(context.types, inspection.covers, matrix, [candidate], [type])
                inspection.warnings = inspection.warnings.append(Warning(context.syntax.patterns[arm.pattern].position, 2, "this match case is unused"))
            matrix = matrix.append([candidate])
        if useful(context.types, inspection.covers, matrix, [0], [type])
            inspection.warnings = inspection.warnings.append(Warning(expression.position, 1, "this match is not exhaustive"))
        inspect_walk(context, expression.children[0], scope, &inspection)
        for arm := expression.arms[]
            names := pattern_names(context.syntax, arm.pattern)
            inspection.candidates = inspection.candidates.concat(names)
            inner := add_names(scope, names)
            inspect_walk(context, arm.body, inner, &inspection)
        return
    for child := expression.children[]
        inspect_walk(context, child, scope, &inspection)

Inspection inspect_item(const parser.Item item, const map<string, lexer.Position> scope, const inference.Context context)
    inspection := Inspection()
    Reference[] references := []
    if item.kind == "declaration"
        inner := inspect_group(context, item.group, scope, true, &inspection)
        parser.Group group := context.syntax.groups[item.group]
        rhs := if recursive_group(group) then inner else scope
        for binding := group.bindings[]
            references = references.concat(pure_references(context.syntax, binding.expression, rhs, false))
    else
        inspect_walk(context, item.expression, scope, &inspection)
        references = pure_references(context.syntax, item.expression, scope, false)
    lexer.Position[] used := []
    for reference := references[]
        if not lexer.has(used, reference.target)
            used = used.append(reference.target)
    for candidate := inspection.candidates[]
        if not candidate.name.starts_with("_") and not lexer.has(used, candidate.position)
            inspection.warnings = inspection.warnings.append(Warning(candidate.position, 4, "unused variable '{candidate.name}'"))
    for: index < int(#inspection.warnings)
        cursor := index
        while cursor > 0
            first := inspection.warnings[cursor]
            second := inspection.warnings[cursor - 1]
            order := lexer.compare_position(first.position, second.position)
            if order > 0 or (order == 0 and first.order >= second.order)
                break
            inspection.warnings[cursor] = second
            inspection.warnings[cursor - 1] = first
            cursor -= 1
    return inspection

string classification_text(const Inspection inspection, const lexer.Position position)
    for entry := inspection.classifications[]
        if entry.position == position
            return " ({entry.text})"
    return ""

class Initial(map<string, un.Scheme> types, map<string, int> values)
class Signature(lexer.Position position, int type)
class Pending(Signature | none signature)
class SignatureFailure(lexer.Position position, string message)

Initial builtins(un.Store &types, evaluator.Context &runtime)
    map<string, un.Scheme> type_environment
    map<string, int> value_environment
    for: iteration < 2
        first := un.fresh(&types)
        second := un.fresh(&types)
        pair := un.add(&types, "pair", first, second)
        function := un.add(&types, "function", pair, if iteration == 0 then first else second)
        .type_environment.set(if iteration == 0 then "fst" else "snd", un.Scheme(function, un.variables(types, function)))
    boolean := un.add(&types, "bool")
    negation := un.add(&types, "function", boolean, boolean)
    .type_environment.set("not", un.Scheme(negation))
    integer := un.add(&types, "int")
    text := un.add(&types, "string")
    conversion := un.add(&types, "function", integer, text)
    .type_environment.set("string_of_int", un.Scheme(conversion))
    result := un.fresh(&types)
    failure := un.add(&types, "function", text, result)
    .type_environment.set("failwith", un.Scheme(failure, [result]))
    names := ["fst", "snd", "not", "string_of_int", "failwith"]
    for name := names[]
        value := evaluator.add(&runtime, evaluator.Value("builtin", text = name))
        .value_environment.set(name, value)
    return Initial(type_environment, value_environment)

void report_diagnostic(const lexer.Position position, string kind, string message, const string[][] sources, string[] &output)
    names := ["prelude.ml", "program.ml"]
    output = output.append("{names[position.file_index]}:{position.line}:{position.column}: {kind}: {message}")
    if position.line <= int(#sources[position.file_index])
        output = output.append("    " + sources[position.file_index][position.line - 1])
        output = output.append(lexer.repeat(" ", position.column + 3) + "^")

void write_output(string name, const string[] lines)
    bool exists := file.is_directory("output")
    if not exists
        file.mkdir("output")
    string text := if #lines == 0 then "" else lines.join(NL) + NL
    writer1 := file.write("output/{name}")
    .writer1(text)

void run_program()
    file_names := ["prelude.ml", "program.ml"]
    string[] texts := []
    string[][] sources := []
    for name := file_names[]
        string text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/{name}"))
        texts = texts.append(text)
        lines := text.split(NL)
        sources = sources.append(lines[0:<int(#lines) - 1])
    syntax := parser.Store()
    persistent_types := un.Store()
    runtime := evaluator.Context(syntax, apply_builtin)
    initial := builtins(&persistent_types, &runtime)
    type_environment := initial.types
    value_environment := initial.values
    map<string, lexer.Position> scope
    string[] types_output := []
    string[] values_output := []
    string[] errors := []
    string[] formatted := []
    int[][] statistics := array(2, fill = [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0])
    for: file_index < 2
        types_output = types_output.append("== {file_names[file_index]} ==")
        values_output = values_output.append("== {file_names[file_index]} ==")
        formatted = formatted.append("(* {file_names[file_index]} *)")
        map<string, Signature> pending
        reading := parser.Parsing(lexer.lex(texts[file_index], file_index), syntax)
        runtime.calls = 0
        while parser.peek(reading).kind != "eof"
            statistics[file_index][0] += 1
            item := parser.item(&reading)
            syntax = reading.syntax
            runtime.syntax = syntax
            match reading.problem
                lexer.Token token
                    message := if token.kind == "invalid" then token.value elif token.kind == "eof" then "unexpected end of file" else "unexpected '{token.spelling}'"
                    statistics[file_index][2] += 1
                    report_diagnostic(token.position, "syntax error", message, sources, &errors)
                    parser.recover(&reading)
                    continue
                none
                    syntax = syntax
            formatted = formatted.append(item_text(syntax, item))
            if item.kind == "signature"
                match pending.get(item.name)
                    Signature old
                        statistics[file_index][5] += 1
                        report_diagnostic(old.position, "warning", "signature for '{item.name}' is never used", sources, &errors)
                    none
                        errors = errors
                .pending.set(item.name, Signature(item.position, item.type))
                continue
            context := inference.Context(persistent_types, syntax)
            next_types := type_environment
            un.Scheme[] schemes := []
            expression_type := -1
            SignatureFailure | none signature_failure := none
            if item.kind == "declaration"
                parser.Group group := syntax.groups[item.group]
                Pending[] signatures := []
                for binding := group.bindings[]
                    signatures = signatures.append(Pending(pending.get(binding.name)))
                    .pending.remove(binding.name)
                inferred := inference.infer_group(&context, item.group, type_environment, false)
                if not inference.failed(context)
                    next_types = inferred.scope_bindings
                    schemes = inferred.schemes
                    for: position < int(#signatures)
                        match signatures[position].signature
                            Signature signature
                                map<string, int> variables
                                declared := signature_type(syntax, signature.type, &context.types, &variables)
                                map<int, int> assigned
                                if not signature_matches(context.types, schemes[position].type, declared, &assigned)
                                    naming := Naming()
                                    inferred_text := type_text(context.types, schemes[position].type, &naming)
                                    declared_text := type_text(context.types, declared, &naming)
                                    parser.Binding binding := group.bindings[position]
                                    signature_failure = SignatureFailure(binding.position, "'{binding.name}' has type {inferred_text} but its signature is {declared_text}")
                                    break
                                schemes[position] = un.Scheme(declared, un.variables(context.types, declared))
                                .next_types.set(group.bindings[position].name, schemes[position])
                            none
                                schemes = schemes
            else
                expression_type = inference.infer_expression(&context, item.expression, type_environment)
            match context.issue
                inference.Issue issue
                    statistics[file_index][3] += 1
                    report_diagnostic(issue.position, "type error", issue_message(issue, context.types), sources, &errors)
                    continue
                none
                    next_types = next_types
            match signature_failure
                SignatureFailure issue
                    statistics[file_index][3] += 1
                    report_diagnostic(issue.position, "type error", issue.message, sources, &errors)
                    continue
                none
                    next_types = next_types
            inspection := inspect_item(item, scope, context)
            if item.kind == "declaration"
                parser.Group group := syntax.groups[item.group]
                for: position < int(#group.bindings)
                    parser.Binding binding := group.bindings[position]
                    naming := Naming()
                    text := type_text(context.types, schemes[position].type, &naming)
                    types_output = types_output.append("{binding.name} : {text}{classification_text(inspection, binding.position)}")
            else
                naming := Naming()
                types_output = types_output.append("- : {type_text(context.types, expression_type, &naming)}")
            inference.Local[] locals := context.locals
            for: position < int(#locals)
                cursor := position
                while cursor > 0 and lexer.compare_position(locals[cursor].position, locals[cursor - 1].position) < 0
                    saved := locals[cursor]
                    locals[cursor] = locals[cursor - 1]
                    locals[cursor - 1] = saved
                    cursor -= 1
            for local_binding := locals[]
                naming := Naming(quantified = local_binding.scheme.quantified)
                text := type_text(context.types, local_binding.scheme.type, &naming)
                types_output = types_output.append("  {local_binding.name} ({local_binding.position.line}:{local_binding.position.column}) : {text}{classification_text(inspection, local_binding.position)}")
            for warning := inspection.warnings[]
                statistics[file_index][5] += 1
                report_diagnostic(warning.position, "warning", warning.message, sources, &errors)
            runtime.issue = none
            next_values := value_environment
            int[] evaluated := []
            if item.kind == "declaration"
                result := evaluator.evaluate_group(&runtime, item.group, value_environment)
                next_values = result.scope_bindings
                evaluated = result.values
            else
                result := evaluator.evaluate(&runtime, item.expression, value_environment)
                evaluated = [result]
            match runtime.issue
                evaluator.Issue issue
                    statistics[file_index][4] += 1
                    report_diagnostic(issue.position, "runtime error", issue.reason, sources, &errors)
                    continue
                none
                    next_values = next_values
            if item.kind == "declaration"
                parser.Group group := syntax.groups[item.group]
                for: position < int(#group.bindings)
                    parser.Binding binding := group.bindings[position]
                    values_output = values_output.append("{binding.name} = {value_text(runtime, evaluated[position])}")
                    .scope.set(binding.name, binding.position)
                statistics[file_index][1] += int(#group.bindings)
            else
                values_output = values_output.append("- = {value_text(runtime, evaluated[0])}")
            type_environment = next_types
            value_environment = next_values
            persistent_types = context.types
        pending_names := pending.keys()
        NamePosition[] unused := []
        for name := pending_names[]
            match pending.get(name)
                Signature signature
                    unused = unused.append(NamePosition(name, signature.position))
                none
                    unused = unused
        for: position < int(#unused)
            cursor := position
            while cursor > 0 and lexer.compare_position(unused[cursor].position, unused[cursor - 1].position) < 0
                saved := unused[cursor]
                unused[cursor] = unused[cursor - 1]
                unused[cursor - 1] = saved
                cursor -= 1
        for entry := unused[]
            statistics[file_index][5] += 1
            report_diagnostic(entry.position, "warning", "signature for '{entry.name}' is never used", sources, &errors)
        statistics[file_index][6] = runtime.calls
        syntax = reading.syntax
    errors = errors.append("== summary ==")
    for: file_index < 2
        counts := statistics[file_index]
        errors = errors.append("{file_names[file_index]}: items={counts[0]} bindings={counts[1]} syntax={counts[2]} type={counts[3]} runtime={counts[4]} warnings={counts[5]} calls={counts[6]}")
    write_output("types.txt", types_output)
    write_output("values.txt", values_output)
    write_output("errors.txt", errors)
    write_output("formatted.ml", formatted)

if main
    run_program()

import lexer = "./lexer.qui"

class Parameter(string name, lexer.Position position)
class Binding(string name, lexer.Position position, int expression)
class Group(lexer.Position | none recursive, Binding[] bindings)
class Arm(int pattern, int body)
class Expr(string kind, lexer.Position position, value := "", int[] children := [], operator_position := lexer.Position(0, 0, 0), parameter := Parameter("_", lexer.Position(0, 0, 0)), group := -1, Arm[] arms := [])
class Pattern(string kind, lexer.Position position, value := "", int[] children := [])
class TypeSyntax(string kind, value := "", int[] children := [])
class Store(Expr[] expressions := [], Pattern[] patterns := [], Group[] groups := [], TypeSyntax[] types := [])
class Item(string kind, name := "", position := lexer.Position(0, 0, 0), type := -1, group := -1, expression := -1)
class Parsing(lexer.Token[] tokens, Store syntax, position := 0, lexer.Token | none problem := none)

int precedence(string operator)
    return if operator == "||" then 1 elif operator == "&&" then 2 elif lexer.has(["=", "<>", "<", ">", "<=", ">="], operator) then 3 elif operator == "::" or operator == "^" then 4 elif operator == "+" or operator == "-" then 5 elif lexer.has(["*", "/", "mod"], operator) then 6 else 0

bool right_associative(string operator)
    return lexer.has(["||", "&&", "::", "^"], operator)

bool failed(const Parsing context)
    match context.problem
        lexer.Token found
            return true
        none
            return false

lexer.Token peek(const Parsing context)
    return context.tokens[context.position]

string word(const Parsing context)
    return peek(context).value

lexer.Token take(Parsing &context)
    if failed(context)
        return peek(context)
    token := peek(context)
    if token.kind != "eof"
        context.position += 1
    return token

void failure(Parsing &context)
    if not failed(context)
        context.problem = peek(context)

lexer.Token expect(Parsing &context, string value)
    if failed(context)
        return peek(context)
    if word(context) != value or peek(context).kind == "invalid"
        failure(&context)
        return peek(context)
    return take(&context)

lexer.Token read_name(Parsing &context)
    if peek(context).kind != "identifier" or word(context) == "_"
        failure(&context)
        return peek(context)
    return take(&context)

Parameter parameter(Parsing &context)
    if peek(context).kind != "identifier"
        failure(&context)
        return Parameter("_", peek(context).position)
    token := take(&context)
    return Parameter(token.value, token.position)

int add_expression(Parsing &context, const Expr expression)
    if failed(context)
        return -1
    index := int(#context.syntax.expressions)
    context.syntax.expressions = context.syntax.expressions.append(expression)
    return index

int add_pattern(Parsing &context, const Pattern pattern)
    if failed(context)
        return -1
    index := int(#context.syntax.patterns)
    context.syntax.patterns = context.syntax.patterns.append(pattern)
    return index

int add_type(Parsing &context, const TypeSyntax type)
    if failed(context)
        return -1
    index := int(#context.syntax.types)
    context.syntax.types = context.syntax.types.append(type)
    return index

bool atomic_start(const Parsing context)
    token := peek(context)
    return lexer.has(["integer", "string"], token.kind) or (token.kind == "identifier" and token.value != "_") or (token.kind != "invalid" and lexer.has(["true", "false", "(", "["], token.value))

int expression(Parsing &context);
int pattern(Parsing &context);
int type_expression(Parsing &context);

int binding_group(Parsing &context)
    opening := expect(&context, "let")
    lexer.Position | none recursive := none
    if word(context) == "rec"
        token := take(&context)
        recursive = token.position
    Binding[] bindings := []
    while not failed(context)
        name := read_name(&context)
        Parameter[] parameters := []
        while not failed(context) and peek(context).kind == "identifier"
            parameters = parameters.append(parameter(&context))
        assignment := expect(&context, "=")
        body := expression(&context)
        if failed(context)
            return -1
        backwards := parameters[::-1]
        for argument := backwards[]
            body = add_expression(&context, Expr("lambda", argument.position, children = [body], parameter = argument))
        bindings = bindings.append(Binding(name.value, name.position, body))
        if word(context) != "and"
            break
        conjunction := take(&context)
    if failed(context)
        return -1
    index := int(#context.syntax.groups)
    context.syntax.groups = context.syntax.groups.append(Group(recursive, bindings))
    return index

int atomic(Parsing &context)
    if failed(context)
        return -1
    token := peek(context)
    if lexer.has(["integer", "string"], token.kind) or (token.kind == "identifier" and token.value != "_")
        consumed := take(&context)
        kind := if token.kind == "identifier" then "name" else token.kind
        return add_expression(&context, Expr(kind, token.position, token.value))
    if token.kind == "invalid"
        failure(&context)
        return -1
    if word(context) == "true" or word(context) == "false"
        consumed := take(&context)
        return add_expression(&context, Expr("bool", token.position, token.value))
    if word(context) == "("
        opening := take(&context)
        first := expression(&context)
        if failed(context)
            return -1
        if word(context) == ","
            comma := take(&context)
            second := expression(&context)
            closing := expect(&context, ")")
            return add_expression(&context, Expr("pair", token.position, children = [first, second]))
        closing := expect(&context, ")")
        return if failed(context) then -1 else first
    if word(context) == "["
        opening := take(&context)
        int[] elements := []
        if word(context) != "]"
            first := expression(&context)
            elements = elements.append(first)
            while not failed(context) and word(context) == ";"
                separator := take(&context)
                next := expression(&context)
                elements = elements.append(next)
        closing := expect(&context, "]")
        return add_expression(&context, Expr("list", token.position, children = elements))
    failure(&context)
    return -1

int unary(Parsing &context)
    if failed(context)
        return -1
    if word(context) == "-"
        token := take(&context)
        operand := unary(&context)
        return add_expression(&context, Expr("negate", token.position, children = [operand], operator_position = token.position))
    function := atomic(&context)
    while not failed(context) and atomic_start(context)
        argument := atomic(&context)
        if failed(context)
            return -1
        function = add_expression(&context, Expr("apply", context.syntax.expressions[function].position, children = [function, argument]))
    return function

int binary(Parsing &context, int minimum)
    left := unary(&context)
    while not failed(context)
        priority := precedence(word(context))
        if priority == 0 or priority < minimum
            break
        operator := take(&context)
        right := binary(&context, if right_associative(operator.value) then priority else priority + 1)
        if failed(context)
            return -1
        left = add_expression(&context, Expr("binary", context.syntax.expressions[left].position, operator.value, [left, right], operator.position))
    return left

int expression(Parsing &context)
    if failed(context)
        return -1
    lexer.Position position := peek(context).position
    initial := word(context)
    if initial == "let"
        group := binding_group(&context)
        inside := expect(&context, "in")
        body := expression(&context)
        return add_expression(&context, Expr("let", position, children = [body], group = group))
    if initial == "fun"
        opening := take(&context)
        parameters := [parameter(&context)]
        while not failed(context) and peek(context).kind == "identifier"
            parameters = parameters.append(parameter(&context))
        arrow := expect(&context, "->")
        body := expression(&context)
        if failed(context)
            return -1
        index := int(#parameters) - 1
        while index >= 0
            body = add_expression(&context, Expr("lambda", if index == 0 then position else parameters[index].position, children = [body], parameter = parameters[index]))
            index -= 1
        return body
    if initial == "if"
        opening := take(&context)
        condition := expression(&context)
        then_token := expect(&context, "then")
        yes := expression(&context)
        else_token := expect(&context, "else")
        no := expression(&context)
        return add_expression(&context, Expr("if", position, children = [condition, yes, no]))
    if initial == "match"
        opening := take(&context)
        value := expression(&context)
        with_token := expect(&context, "with")
        if word(context) == "|"
            bar := take(&context)
        Arm[] arms := []
        while not failed(context)
            matched := pattern(&context)
            arrow := expect(&context, "->")
            body := expression(&context)
            arms = arms.append(Arm(matched, body))
            if word(context) != "|"
                break
            bar := take(&context)
        return add_expression(&context, Expr("match", position, children = [value], arms = arms))
    return binary(&context, 1)

int atomic_pattern(Parsing &context)
    if failed(context)
        return -1
    token := peek(context)
    if lexer.has(["integer", "string", "identifier"], token.kind)
        consumed := take(&context)
        kind := if token.kind == "identifier" then (if token.value == "_" then "wild" else "name") else token.kind
        return add_pattern(&context, Pattern(kind, token.position, token.value))
    if token.kind == "invalid"
        failure(&context)
        return -1
    if token.value == "true" or token.value == "false"
        consumed := take(&context)
        return add_pattern(&context, Pattern("bool", token.position, token.value))
    if token.value == "-"
        minus := take(&context)
        if peek(context).kind != "integer"
            failure(&context)
            return -1
        number := take(&context)
        value := int(number.value)
        return add_pattern(&context, Pattern("integer", token.position, string(-value)))
    if token.value == "("
        opening := take(&context)
        first := pattern(&context)
        if failed(context)
            return -1
        if word(context) == ","
            comma := take(&context)
            second := pattern(&context)
            closing := expect(&context, ")")
            return add_pattern(&context, Pattern("pair", token.position, children = [first, second]))
        closing := expect(&context, ")")
        return if failed(context) then -1 else first
    if token.value == "["
        opening := take(&context)
        int[] elements := []
        if word(context) != "]"
            first := pattern(&context)
            elements = elements.append(first)
            while not failed(context) and word(context) == ";"
                separator := take(&context)
                next := pattern(&context)
                elements = elements.append(next)
        closing := expect(&context, "]")
        return add_pattern(&context, Pattern("list", token.position, children = elements))
    failure(&context)
    return -1

int pattern(Parsing &context)
    head := atomic_pattern(&context)
    if not failed(context) and word(context) == "::"
        separator := take(&context)
        tail := pattern(&context)
        if failed(context)
            return -1
        return add_pattern(&context, Pattern("cons", context.syntax.patterns[head].position, children = [head, tail]))
    return head

int type_atom(Parsing &context)
    if failed(context)
        return -1
    token := peek(context)
    if token.kind == "type_variable"
        consumed := take(&context)
        return add_type(&context, TypeSyntax("variable", token.value))
    if token.kind == "identifier" and lexer.has(["int", "bool", "string"], token.value)
        consumed := take(&context)
        return add_type(&context, TypeSyntax(token.value))
    if token.kind == "symbol" and token.value == "("
        opening := take(&context)
        value := type_expression(&context)
        closing := expect(&context, ")")
        return if failed(context) then -1 else value
    failure(&context)
    return -1

int list_type(Parsing &context)
    type := type_atom(&context)
    while not failed(context) and peek(context).kind == "identifier" and word(context) == "list"
        list_token := take(&context)
        type = add_type(&context, TypeSyntax("list", children = [type]))
    return type

int product_type(Parsing &context)
    first := list_type(&context)
    if not failed(context) and word(context) == "*"
        product := take(&context)
        second := list_type(&context)
        return add_type(&context, TypeSyntax("pair", children = [first, second]))
    return first

int type_expression(Parsing &context)
    first := product_type(&context)
    if not failed(context) and word(context) == "->"
        arrow := take(&context)
        second := type_expression(&context)
        return add_type(&context, TypeSyntax("function", children = [first, second]))
    return first

Item item(Parsing &context)
    context.problem = none
    lexer.Position position := peek(context).position
    result := Item("expression")
    if word(context) == "val"
        keyword := take(&context)
        name := read_name(&context)
        colon := expect(&context, ":")
        type := type_expression(&context)
        result = Item("signature", name.value, name.position, type = type)
    elif word(context) == "let"
        group := binding_group(&context)
        if not failed(context) and word(context) == "in"
            inside := take(&context)
            body := expression(&context)
            local_let := add_expression(&context, Expr("let", position, children = [body], group = group))
            result = Item("expression", expression = local_let)
        else
            result = Item("declaration", group = group)
    else
        body := expression(&context)
        result = Item("expression", expression = body)
    ending := expect(&context, ";;")
    return result

void recover(Parsing &context)
    context.problem = none
    while peek(context).kind != "eof" and word(context) != ";;"
        skipped := take(&context)
    if word(context) == ";;"
        skipped := take(&context)
    context.problem = none

class Type(string kind, first := -1, second := -1, binding := -1)
class Scheme(int type, int[] quantified := [])
class Store(Type[] nodes := [])
class Failure(int expected, int found, bool occurs, bool nested)

bool has(const int[] values, int sought)
    for value := values[]
        if value == sought
            return true
    return false

int[] unique(const int[] values)
    int[] result := []
    for value := values[]
        if not has(result, value)
            result = result.append(value)
    return result

int add(Store &store, string kind, first := -1, second := -1)
    index := int(#store.nodes)
    store.nodes = store.nodes.append(Type(kind, first, second))
    return index

int fresh(Store &store)
    return add(&store, "variable")

int resolve(const Store store, int original)
    current := original
    while store.nodes[current].kind == "variable" and store.nodes[current].binding >= 0
        current = store.nodes[current].binding
    return current

bool same(const Store store, int first, int second)
    left := resolve(store, first)
    right := resolve(store, second)
    if left == right
        return true
    a := store.nodes[left]
    b := store.nodes[right]
    if a.kind != b.kind or a.kind == "variable"
        return false
    if a.kind == "list"
        return same(store, a.first, b.first)
    if a.kind == "pair" or a.kind == "function"
        return same(store, a.first, b.first) and same(store, a.second, b.second)
    return true

int[] variables(const Store store, int original)
    index := resolve(store, original)
    type := store.nodes[index]
    if type.kind == "variable"
        return [index]
    if type.kind == "list"
        return variables(store, type.first)
    if type.kind == "pair" or type.kind == "function"
        return unique(variables(store, type.first).concat(variables(store, type.second)))
    return []

Failure | none unify(Store &store, int expected, int found, nested := false)
    left := resolve(store, expected)
    right := resolve(store, found)
    if same(store, left, right)
        return none
    a := store.nodes[left]
    b := store.nodes[right]
    if a.kind == "variable"
        if has(variables(store, right), left)
            return Failure(left, right, true, nested)
        store.nodes[left].binding = right
        return none
    if b.kind == "variable"
        if has(variables(store, left), right)
            return Failure(left, right, true, nested)
        store.nodes[right].binding = left
        return none
    if a.kind == b.kind and (a.kind == "list" or a.kind == "pair" or a.kind == "function")
        match unify(&store, a.first, b.first, true)
            Failure failure
                return failure
            none
                if a.kind == "list"
                    return none
                return unify(&store, a.second, b.second, true)
    return Failure(left, right, false, nested)

Scheme generalize(const Store store, int type, const map<string, Scheme> scope_bindings)
    result := variables(store, type)
    schemes := scope_bindings.values()
    for scheme := schemes[]
        free := variables(store, scheme.type)
        int[] remaining := []
        for variable := result[]
            if not has(free, variable) or has(scheme.quantified, variable)
                remaining = remaining.append(variable)
        result = remaining
    return Scheme(type, result)

int replace(Store &store, int original, const map<int, int> replacements)
    index := resolve(store, original)
    type := store.nodes[index]
    if type.kind == "variable"
        match replacements.get(index)
            int found
                return found
            none
                return index
    if type.kind == "list"
        element := replace(&store, type.first, replacements)
        return add(&store, "list", element)
    if type.kind == "pair" or type.kind == "function"
        first := replace(&store, type.first, replacements)
        second := replace(&store, type.second, replacements)
        return add(&store, type.kind, first, second)
    return index

int instantiate(Store &store, const Scheme scheme)
    map<int, int> replacements
    ordered := scheme.quantified.sorted()
    for variable := ordered[]
        created := fresh(&store)
        .replacements.set(variable, created)
    return replace(&store, scheme.type, replacements)
